description:
Connectivity client for AWS Verified Access, providing secure access to corporate applications without a VPN.

The AWS Verified Access connectivity client provides secure connectivity to AWS Verified Access endpoints. AWS Verified Access delivers secure access to corporate applications without a VPN, evaluating every request against trust-based access policies so users get access to applications, not to your network.
The client installs a system tray application and a background service that establishes connectivity to your Verified Access endpoints over AWS private network paths. It is required for users accessing applications through Verified Access endpoints configured with the connectivity client as their access method.
